page.title: Shifts
page.off: The shift system is not switched on yet. It is opening gradually, one rikma at a time.
page.shadow: Trial mode: declarations are saved and the roster is computed, but it is not sent to anyone and does not bind anyone yet.
page.loadError: We could not load the shifts right now. The rest of the rikma works as usual.
page.empty: This rikma has no mission with a staffing plan yet.
page.emptyHint: A staffing plan is made from a mission: in the mission form, mark that it needs to be staffed at set hours.
page.notOnMission: You are not on this mission, so there is nothing for you to declare here. To take part, ask to join the mission.

phase.upcoming: Declarations for this cycle open on {{date}}
phase.declaring: Declarations are open. The draft is published on {{date}}
phase.draft: The draft is out. You can release, swap or volunteer until {{date}}
phase.closed: The roster for this cycle is closed

grid.tapHint: Tap a shift to move between: want to → can → if needed → can't. The star marks a top choice.
grid.saveError: The change was not saved. Please try again.

roster.noDraft: The roster appears here once the draft is published.
roster.shadowNote: Trial roster: this is what the roster would look like. It has not been sent to anyone and binds nobody.

reason.onlyCandidate: The only one who declared for this shift
reason.ownPreference: Marked it as a top choice
reason.belowQuota: Furthest below their share this cycle
reason.owed: Got less than their share in earlier cycles
reason.tieBreak: A fixed draw between exactly equal candidates
reason.overQuota: Beyond their share — nobody else was available; it evens out next cycle
reason.backup: In line — called if someone releases
reason.volunteered: Volunteered for a shift that was short
reason.swapped: A swap both sides agreed to
reason.cover: Stepped in for someone who released

fairness.intro: Everyone gets the same number of shifts, except where their own commitment caps them lower or lifts them higher.
fairness.noSnapshot: Shares are computed when this cycle's draft is published.
fairness.shortage: {{count}} shifts are not covered by any commitment in the rikma — a call to fill the holes will open.
fairness.carryHelp: Positive: got more than their share before, so the next share is smaller. Negative: is owed.

why.belowMin: Below the minimum — not enough shifts this cycle
